tasks.title: Setup Authentication System
tasks.description: Implement a secure authentication system using JWT tokens and bcrypt password hashing. The system should support login, logout, and protected route access. hello do it asap
tasks.approach: 1. Create login API route that verifies credentials against the database. 2. Sign a JWT token with user payload. 3. Store token in HTTP-only cookie. 4. Implement middleware to verify token on every request. 5. Add logout endpoint to clear cookies.

tasks.title: Build Task Dashboard UI
tasks.description: Design and implement the task dashboard with filtering by status, priority indicators, and real-time updates when tasks change state.
tasks.approach: 1. Create task card component with status badges. 2. Add tab-based filter for All / Pending / Processing / Complete. 3. Support click-through navigation to task detail page. 4. Use optimistic updates for a snappy UX.

tasks.title: Integrate JSON Server as Backend
tasks.description: Set up json-server as a mock REST API backend. Configure all CRUD endpoints for users and tasks. Add cors and custom middleware support.
tasks.approach: 1. Install json-server via npm. 2. Define db.json schema with users and tasks. 3. Add start script to package.json. 4. Create Next.js API proxy routes for client-side calls. 5. Seed the database with initial data.

tasks.title: Task Detail & Edit Page
tasks.description: Build a task detail page that shows all task fields and allows inline editing. Users should be able to modify any field and save changes back to the server.
tasks.approach: 1. Create dynamic route /tasks/[id]. 2. Fetch task data server-side. 3. Render a read view with an Edit button. 4. Switch to form mode on edit click. 5. PATCH updated fields to /api/tasks/[id]. 6. Show success toast on save.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Auth Flow
tasks.description: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests for the login API route, middleware token verification, and logout flow.
tasks.approach: 1. Use Jest + Testing Library. 2. Mock JSON server responses. 3. Test valid login, invalid credentials, expired token, and logout scenarios. 4. Add CI workflow with GitHub Actions.

tasks.title: Mobile Responsiveness Audit
tasks.description: Audit all pages for mobile responsiveness. Fix layout issues, ensure the task list collapses to a single column, and test on common device sizes.
tasks.approach: 1. Test on 320px, 375px, 768px breakpoints. 2. Use Tailwind responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:). 3. Fix sidebar collapse on mobile. 4. Test with Chrome DevTools device emulation.
